newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egypt o/n rates narrow, one week range widens.
newsitem.headline: Egypt o/n rates narrow, one week range widens.

text.p: Overnight interbank rates on the Egyptian pound narrowed to seven and 7-1/2 percent in a traditionally liquid private sector market on Thursday from Wednesday's range of seven and 8-1/2 percent, bankers said.
Most bankers did not make one-week deals at the end of the business week. Those who quoted one-week rates, said they were between seven and 8-1/4 percent against seven and eight percent on Wednesday.
The Egyptian Central Bank on Thursday cut the discount rate to 12.25 from 12.75 pecernt. Bankers told Reuters a day earlier the current liquidity would help push rates down.
"This level of interest rates does not encourage people to invest," one banker has said. "The reasonable level is around nine-ten percent for borrowers."
Bankers said that public sector banks kept their minimum lending rate steady at 10-1/2 percent.
